create_parlai_parser: create a ParlaiParser instance to parse CLI arguments for a ParlAI task or model
parse_args_with_parlai_parser: parse command line arguments using ParlaiParser.parse_args and get an opt dictionary
add_custom_argument_to_parser: add a custom argument to a ParlaiParser using add_argument with type conversion support
parse_kwargs_into_opts: parse keyword arguments into ParlAI opts using ParlaiParser.parse_kwargs for programmatic config
convert_class_string_to_class: convert a module:class string to an actual Python class using the str2class function
